messages:
Janet: FYI Orion Systems asked to delay full pilot rollout until Q3 budget clears. Theyd still like a light onboarding to keep stakeholders engaged. Suggest a 2-week sandbox + 30m exec demo.
Omar: Can we do a smaller scope (embeddings + similarity) so we reduce support overhead? Thats usually easier to demo to product teams.
Ivy (Orion Systems): That works. Clinical ops wants to see similarity search on their taxonomy. Legal still needs a short DPA, but procurement said sandbox helps unblock stakeholder demos.
Keiko: We can provision a US-hosted sandbox and add a retention policy (7 days) to satisfy DPA concerns. Recommend token cap $800 and 10-day timebox.
Leo: I'll create a 1-pager for execs: 3 sample queries, latency p50/p95, and early quality notes. Also will include a short teardown for procurement (DPA link + contact).
Janet: @Ivy please confirm demo attendees and availability for a 30m slot next Thu 9am PT. Also adding "budget_delay" tag in Gainsight and marking health as "at-risk" until PO is signed.
Ivy (Orion Systems): Pinged attendees, likely 4 people. Thu 9am PT should work. Will update when procurement gives timeline.
Omar: Provision command (devops note): ```rb prov sandbox --org orion-systems --env trial --region us-east-1 --model redwood-embed-v1 --tokens 80000 --timebox 10d``` ETA ~90m.
SchedulerBot: Sandbox orion-systems-trial created by leo at 1839999950 (region us-east-1, token_cap 80000).
Keiko: Next steps recap: 1) Sandbox provisioning (Leo) 2) 30m exec demo Thu 9am PT (Janet + Ivy) 3) 1-pager + procurement note (Leo) 4) Gainsight tags updated (Janet). I'll follow up with post-demo micro-survey link. :party_popper:
